description: This file provides authentication-related service functions such as login, signup, and logout that interface with a backend API. It exports functions to handle user authentication processes by making POST requests to specific endpoints and processing the responses.

methods.name: login(email, password)
methods.description: Authenticates a user by sending email and password to the backend, returning a standardized response object.

methods.name: signup(name, email, password)
methods.description: Registers a new user account by sending name, email, and password to the backend, returning a response indicating success and user data.

methods.name: logout()
methods.description: Attempts to log out the user by calling the backend logout endpoint; errors are ignored.
